title: The Beast of Millbrook
description: Millbrook's flocks are down by half. Ansel Crake lost his last sheep two nights ago and will not take his cart out after dark. Three hunting parties out of that village have already missed it.

objectives.description: Ask the Millbrook elder what has been taken
Track the beast to its lair
Clear the rest of the pack

notes: Rank: Member -> Veteran (promotion). Monster hunt with tracking mechanics. Dire wolf spawns in den near Millbrook. Promotion to Veteran rank on completion. Threat: a named shepherd, Ansel Crake, has lost his whole flock, and the village's own hunting parties have failed three times. Giver motive: Vorn only calls something Veteran-tier once local hunters have already failed. Consequence: more of Millbrook's livestock and, eventually, people, are named as at risk if it isn't found - stated in prose, not wired.
